authority: Direct user request 2026-09-28: optimize usage limits and capacity; choose an appropriate model per task. Preserve sole integrator and active task ownership.

none.purpose: Idle, status, hashes, schema/index operations use scripts

inherit.purpose: Keep the recipient current model, especially main approval/integration

economy.purpose: Small semantic summary or mechanical documentation only; arithmetic, hashes, status and indexing remain no-model. No independent verdict.

standard.purpose: Bounded implementation, UX work, package preparation and execution of an already authorized QA plan.

review.purpose: Independent bounded code/evidence review; escalate material cross-module uncertainty to critical.

critical.purpose: Architecture, permissions/data migration, consequential diagnosis, full readiness audit and difficult cross-module decisions.

available_models_verified_from: Current Codex app and collaboration tool model schemas, 2026-09-28; request is not proof of actual runtime selection.
limitations: Applies to subsequent assignments; currently running tasks keep their model and context.
FLOW_POLICY does not by itself change .codex roles or runtime defaults. Sole integrator applies separately reviewed role/config deltas.
No measured token, latency or monetary savings claim.
No new permissions for product claims, integration, tests, runtime, migration, cutover or attempts.
Current goal and full readiness criteria remain unchanged; an efficiency change is not acceptance.

routing_rules.enforcement_scope: profiles are consumed by existing bos_flow handoff; additional rules are orchestrator instructions, not a new automatic scheduler or execution gate
order: No model call when no actionable change
Use existing deterministic commands for status/hash/index/byte equality
Choose economy for narrow semantic preparation
Choose standard for bounded implementation or authorized QA
routing_rules.existing_idle_agent_reuse: Reuse when its confirmed configuration fits. An idle agent with a heavy inherited configuration is not an economy substitute; use a new bounded subagent if the API cannot reconfigure the idle one.
routing_rules.full_history_fork: Only when the task requires that history; default to standalone short context for independent work.
no_model_activities: copying an already accepted immutable package
routing_rules.escalation: One evidence-based escalation of the same authorized task when reasoning complexity requires it; never use a new model/ID/agent to reset an execution cap or owner gate.
routing_rules.independent_review: One actual independent review of the relevant change. Reuse its exact hash for unchanged evidence; no new model review just to restate its verdict.
routing_rules.actual_model: Store requested model/effort separately from observed runtime model; unknown remains unknown.

capacity_policy.resource_checks: Use a fresh already authorized resource observation before heavy work. Unknown/low memory means no new heavy job; this policy grants no process/RAM/policy probe.
capacity_policy.limit_pressure: On an actual quota error stop duplicate retries and preserve the result. A smaller model may receive only a suitable already authorized next task after its availability is verified; no automatic downgrade of acceptance or critical decisions.
capacity_policy.reset_credit: Never automatically use or purchase a reset.
capacity_policy.idle: No agent spawned or awakened merely to keep a slot busy.
capacity_policy.event_driven: Existing heartbeat is a fallback. Poll a confirmed live handle with a bounded wait, or act on a new result/blocker; do not add timers or empty model loops.
